description: When the local service is down, the panel, editor and page save-error heading is the raw browser exception "Failed to fetch".
expected: Plain language naming the cause and the next step, such as "Pardner on this computer didn't answer. Your change is saved in this tab; retry once Pardner is running."
actual: Red heading "Failed to fetch", then "Your last confirmed data remains available."
suggested_fix: Map TypeError/network failures in the mutation path to the same local-service copy the connection banner uses.

criterion: Network failure: retry option, data preserved
description: After the service comes back and the header reads "Saved locally · synced", the red "Failed to fetch" block from the earlier retry stays under the header. The board looks synced and failed at the same time, and nothing says the retry should now succeed.
expected: On reconnect the stale error is replaced by a calm "Pardner is back. Retry your saved change" prompt, or the replay runs automatically, since the operation ID makes it safe.
actual: The stale error remains until Retry saved request is clicked.
suggested_fix: Clear the transport error on successful reconnect and show the pending notice. Consider replaying the pending operation automatically on reconnect.

description: With the service stopped, the project switcher reads "Saved locally · synced · unconfirmed change" while the header reads "Local service disconnected".
expected: The switcher label reflects the current connection state, or omits sync state when it is not known.
suggested_fix: Derive the switcher label for the open project from the live SaveStatus instead of the last /session snapshot.

description: A replayed quick Status change that meets a newer edit shows "This field changed since it was read; refresh its context" / "Your draft is preserved." There is no draft for a select.
expected: "Someone moved this task to Dead end while your change was waiting. Your change to Review was not applied."
actual: Developer-style heading, and a draft claim that does not apply.
suggested_fix: Choose the STALE_UPDATE copy by the source of the change, and name the competing value.

description: Right after the outage begins, the task panel still shows "Here now" with Priya's avatar and a green active dot, and the header avatars stay green, while SaveStatus reads "Local service disconnected".
expected: Presence greys out, or is marked unknown, once the local service is unreachable.
actual: Active presence is shown during the outage.
suggested_fix: Mark presence stale when the presence poll or socket fails.

description: At 390x844 the wrapped header, the pending notice and the did-not-respond banner use about 490px. Only the column headers of the board are visible above the fold.
expected: One combined compact status banner on narrow viewports.
suggested_fix: Merge the pending notice into the connection banner when both are present.

description: The pending state shows in four places (the panel notice, the page notice, the switcher suffix and the disabled New task), and the disconnect shows in three (the header SaveStatus, the panel SaveStatus and the banner).
expected: One pending surface and one connection surface.
actual: Up to seven indicators for two facts.
suggested_fix: Keep the page-level notices. Drop the panel SaveStatus duplicate while a page banner is showing.
